Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1957 (Insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, and assays to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1957, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
